title: Unnati Hooda, Tanvi Sharma Set for All-Indian Syed Modi Semifinal
indian_angle: This match guarantees an Indian finalist in the women's singles at the Syed Modi International, highlighting the depth of talent in Indian badminton.
summary: Last year’s semi-finalist Unnati Hooda overcame compatriot Anmol, while Tanvi Sharma got the better of Indonesia’s Ni Kadek Pratiwi, setting up an exciting all-Indian clash.

title: BWF's Thomas and Uber Cup Overhaul Divides Badminton Community
indian_angle: The proposed changes to major team events like the Thomas and Uber Cup will significantly impact India's strategic planning and team composition for future international competitions.
summary: The BWF's proposed revamp for the Thomas and Uber Cup, aiming for shorter ties and more global representation, has met with mixed reactions across the badminton community.

title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand Advance to Syed Modi Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand continue their strong performance at an international event held in India.
summary: The defending champions beat compatriots Shreya Balaji and Pranavi Natarajan 21-9, 21-8 to secure their spot in the quarterfinals of the Syed Modi International.

title: Indian Team Selection Criteria for Asia Mixed Team Championships 2027 Released
indian_angle: This outlines the pathway for Indian players to represent the country at a significant continental team championship.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the selection criteria for the Indian team that will participate in the Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships 2027.

title: India Invited to Host More BWF International Challenge Tournaments
indian_angle: Hosting more international tournaments in India provides valuable exposure and ranking opportunities for Indian players on home soil.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has received an invitation to host two additional BWF Grade 3 (International Challenge) tournaments during the 2027–2029 period, expanding India's presence on the international badminton circuit.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Announced for December
indian_angle: This is the premier national event where India's top senior players compete for national titles and recognition.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th.
